# gradle-cache

Gradle's dependency caches, downloaded Gradle versions and daemon logs.

**Name:** Gradle cache · **Category:** Package caches · **Status:** stable · **Systems:** macOS, Linux, Windows

Upstream docs: <https://docs.gradle.org/current/userguide/directory_layout.html>

**Detected when** one of `{gradle_home}` exists.

## Paths

Resolved in this order: the tool's own command, then the environment variable, then the system default.

- `{gradle_home}`: `$GRADLE_USER_HOME` → default `~/.gradle`

## Locations

| Path | Item | Safety | Why | Actions |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `{gradle_home}/caches` | Gradle dependency caches | Safe | This is a download cache; it is fetched again when needed (`REDOWNLOADABLE`) | `quarantine` |
| `{gradle_home}/wrapper/dists` (one item per entry) | Gradle {name} | Safe; newest 1 kept | This is a download cache; it is fetched again when needed (`REDOWNLOADABLE`) | `quarantine` |
| `{gradle_home}/daemon` | Gradle daemon logs | Safe | Your build tools recreate this automatically (`REGENERABLE`) | `quarantine` |

## In use

Items are Keep while one of these runs: `java|GradleDaemon`.
